observations: Three photos show the same standing fan in different color variations: black (photo 0), white (photo 1), and dark gray (photo 2).
Each fan has a circular protective grille, three blades, a central hub with a logo (a stylized 'B' or 'BB' in a circle), and a black or white pole with an orange or gold accent near the base.
The base is a black, five-spoke wheel-like design, common in standing fans.
The power cord is visible in photo 0 and photo 2, with a 3-pin plug (photo 0) and a 2-pin plug (photo 2).
The fan is shown in a static position; no motion is visible in any photo.
The background is consistent across photos: tiled floor, white wall, and a dark wooden door.
The watermark 'STANDARD HOMES SOLUTIONS' is present on all photos.

claims.evidence: Photos show no visible dirt or damage, but no proof of operation. The fan is static in all images.

claims.claim: Sides-wards rotation and fixed positions work perfectly
claims.evidence: No photo shows the fan in motion or in different angles to confirm side-to-side rotation. The mechanism for rotation is not visible.

risks.risk: Fan may not work or may have motor issues
risks.proof: A video clip showing the fan running at different speeds and turning on/off.

risks.risk: Side-to-side rotation mechanism may be broken or stiff
risks.proof: A video showing the fan rotating from side to side and locking into fixed positions.

risks.risk: Power cord or plug may be damaged or incompatible
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the plug and cord, showing no fraying or damage, and confirming compatibility with Nigerian outlets.

proof_requests: Video of the fan running and rotating side-to-side.
Close-up of the power cord and plug.
Photo of the control panel or switch, if any.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a standing fan, but its functionality and key features (rotation, working condition) cannot be confirmed from the photos alone. The seller's claims about operation and rotation are unverified or unverifiable remotely. Proof of operation and rotation is required before pricing.
